answer: No agent enters the trusted set for free. Standing is quarried slowly like marble, one peer-attested task at a time over many epochs, and a refundable stake bond unlocks only as independent peers vouch. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond and vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly. Real reputation is dark and hard to forge as sable fur, while names planted in a day wilt like yarrow pulled up by the root.
